cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl

rng = random.Random(5)
for L in (3,4,5):
    for k in (10,):
        svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(24)]
        specs = [tuple(rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(L)) for _ in range(k)]
        req = {'services':svc,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in specs]}}],
               'queries':[[svc[0],svc[1]]]}
        parsed = impl.parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
        t0=time.time()
        try:
            order, trans, const_truth, kept, truth, nrep, col_of = impl.build_product(parsed['atoms'], 24)
            prod = len(order)
        except impl.ComplexityError:
            print('L=%d product>20000'%L); continue
        t1=time.time()
        out = impl.compile_bundle(parsed)
        t2=time.time()
        o = json.loads(out)
        print('L=%d product=%d min=%d nrep=%d build=%.2fs total=%.2fs outlen=%d' % (L, prod, len(o['dfa']['next']), nrep, t1-t0, t2-t0, len(out)))
EOF
